summary: TIM S.A. filed a 6-K 'Material Fact' disclosing Poste Italiane's voluntary public tender and exchange offer for Telecom Italia (TI) ordinary shares. Following the initial acceptance period, Poste holds approximately 66.627% of TI, including prior holdings and tendered shares, with consideration settlement on September 18, 2026. Poste thus became TI's controlling shareholder and, indirectly, TIM Brasil's controlling shareholder. The acceptance period reopened September 21–25, 2026, per applicable regulations. TIM Brasil is the filer/target of the indirect change of control, not the bidder. Watch the reopened window and any resultant minority squeeze-out or delisting mechanics.
